note: FALKOR_NO_HARDCODED_SELECTABLES_DGO_20260929_01: the request parameters of the Fan Vibes model call. The model itself is the operator's global chat pick, read from Falkor per run. The Ollama chat endpoint is ollama_chat_url (the OLLAMA_CHAT_URL environment variable overrides it). A missing value is refused (Fan Vibes is then disclosed as unavailable), never filled in from code.
